clock.description: Plain digits, or a split-flap display whose digits flip when the minute changes. With the date, if you want it.

4x2.note: Four cells wide and two tall.
4x2.alt: The clock widget in its split-flap style, showing the time and the date.

4x1.note: Four cells wide and one tall: the time on a slim card.
4x1.alt: The clock widget at 4x1: the time and the date on a slim card.

2x1.note: Two cells wide and one tall.
2x1.alt: The clock widget at 2x1: the time and the date on a half-width card.

1x1.note: One cell, which also fits a slot of the dock.
1x1.alt: The clock widget at 1x1: the time on a square card.

stats.description: Any reading as a number or a gauge: CPU, memory and GPU load, temperature, power and clock.

4x4.note: Four gauges above three text readings.
4x4.alt: The stats widget at 4x4: four gauges for CPU load, GPU temperature, GPU load and memory, above three text readings.

4x2.note: Two readings on top, three text readings below.
4x2.alt: The stats widget at 4x2: a bar for CPU load and a memory gauge above three text readings.

2x2.note: One reading on a square card.
2x2.alt: The stats widget at 2x2: one reading with its gauge.

1x1.note: One reading on one cell, which also fits a slot of the dock.
1x1.alt: The stats widget at 1x1: one reading.

weather.description: Animated icons and the forecast for any number of places, from Open-Meteo.

4x4.note: Current conditions with the forecast for the days ahead.
4x4.alt: The weather widget at 4x4: current conditions and a five-day forecast.

4x2.note: Current conditions on a shorter card.
4x2.alt: The weather widget at 4x2: current conditions.

shortcut.description: The icon of an application, a folder or a web address. Tap it and it opens. A dock keeps up to four of them in the same place on every page.

1x1.note: One cell each, on a page or in the dock.
1x1.alt: The dock with four shortcuts: GitHub, Wikipedia, Steam and VS Code.
